subject: Supplemental SOC 2 artifacts — MFA rotation windows & targeted access-review snapshots
messages:
From: Samira Khan <samira.k@apexhealth.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Apr 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Request: supplemental SOC 2 artifacts for April audit

Hi Jordan,

Hope you’re well — we’re starting the targeted portion of our SOC 2 Type II review for the April window and need a few supplemental artifacts beyond the SOC 2 report. The items we specifically want to review are:

- Rotation windows and documented policy for long-lived tokens and service-account keys (last 12 months)
- Sample evidence of MFA rotation/seed rotation and any exceptions logged during the period
- A targeted snapshot of access-review output (April 1–15, 2027) showing reviewers, approval outcomes, and remediation tickets
- A brief note (or bridge letter) describing which controls are covered by the SOC report vs. the supplemental extracts

If you can provide the artifacts or tell us when we can expect them this week, that would help keep the audit on schedule. We are happy to review a redacted bundle if there are sensitive fields.

Thanks — ideally we’d receive: rotation policy CSV, access-review snapshot ZIP, and a one-page bridge letter.

Best,
Samira Khan
Senior Security Auditor
Apex Health Systems

[attachment: audit_requirements_v1.pdf (PDF)]

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira.k@apexhealth.com>
Cc: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Apr 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: supplemental SOC 2 artifacts for April audit

Hi Samira — thanks for the clear list. We can assemble the bundle and deliver a draft bridge letter. Internal owners below for transparency.

Plan / timeline:
- Olga will export the access-review snapshot covering Apr 1–15 (will redact user emails as needed) — target delivery: EOD Monday (5/3).
- I’ll pull the rotation-policy snapshot (key/token rotation metadata) and a short CSV summarizing rotation windows & exceptions — target delivery: EOD Tuesday (5/4).
- Marissa will draft the bridge letter that maps SOC 2 control criteria to the supplemental extracts — draft by Monday close of business (5/3).

Deliverables we’ll attach: rotation_policy_snapshot.csv, access-review-snapshot-202704.zip, bridge_letter_draft.pdf. If you need logs (auth events) rather than the access-review table, let me know now so we can prepare slices.

Two quick clarifications: are you ok with the April 1–15 timebox only, or do you want rolling 30-day samples? Also let us know if you require a signed bridge letter or a redacted bundle is sufficient for your team.

Thanks — I’ll keep you posted.

Jordan Blake
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123
https://redwood.com/

Date: Sat, 01 May 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: supplemental SOC 2 artifacts for April audit

Folks — quick status and scope notes from the security team.

What I will provide (deliverable names included):
- access-review-snapshot-202704.zip — CSVs: reviewer_log.csv, review_outcomes.csv, remediation_tickets.csv. These will include employee IDs; we will redact emails and phone numbers per our data-handling policy.
- rotation_policy_snapshot.csv — fields: credential_id, type (service-account|api-token|ssh-key), last_rotation_iso, rotation_interval_days, exception_flag, ticket_id. The CSV will include the last 12 months for tokens/keys that fall under SOC scoping.
- bridge_letter_draft.pdf — Marissa will draft; I’ll review for technical accuracy.

Constraints / notes:
- We cannot export full auth event traces with raw IPs without a formal data-access exception; if Apex needs those we’ll need a signed NDA-addendum.
- Rotation metadata for some third-party-managed keys is limited; I’ll flag those rows in the CSV.

I’ll upload the artifacts to the shared Drive folder and post the link here once ready. Target EOD Monday 5/3 for the access snapshot and bridge letter draft, rotation CSV by EOD 5/4.

—Olga
Olga Petrov
Director, Security & Compliance | Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.com

Thanks Jordan / Olga — this timeline works for us. Two quick follow-ups: 

1) For the bridge letter, we need a one-paragraph description that explicitly states whether the SOC 2 scope covers rotation-policy enforcement and access-review process (language is fine to say "SOC 2 assesses control design and operating effectiveness; supplemental extracts provide operational evidence").

2) We’d like to schedule a 30-minute call on Tuesday (5/4) at 11:00 AM PT to walk the access-review snapshot with Olga. Can you confirm?

Also: please upload the artifacts to a shared location and paste the Drive link in the thread when available. For our file-tracking, include the filename pattern you used and a short MD5/hash if possible.
